target_url.description: The target URL to scan (ex: http://10.10.10.10/path)

word_list_path.description: Path to the word list file to be tested

max_tasks.description: Number of concurrent connections in parallel per host

output_file.description: Output file to save results to disk. Empty string means stdout/none.

extensions.description: Extensions to append to each request. Use items schema for content.

extensions_items.description: A single extension to append (e.g. html, xml, php)

ignore_restore.description: Ignore an existing restore file (don't wait 10 seconds)

double_path.description: Multiply a payload set to search 2 path levels

report_proxy.description: Target proxy URL to report only successful requests

deep_search.description: Deep Search: Look for URLs inside of HTML results

verbose.description: Shows more options and prints commands and outputs

no_forward_location.description: Disable forward to Location response address

ignore_result_filter.description: Ignore results by result code or/and size (ex: 302 or 302:172)

find_text.description: Text to find in content or header. Use items schema.

find_text_items.description: A text string to find in response content or headers

http_method.description: Specify request method (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, HEAD, OPTIONS, all)

random_agent.description: Use randomly selected HTTP User-Agent header value

headers.description: JSON-formatted header key/value pairs. Use items schema.

headers_items.description: A single header entry in format 'Key: Value'

case_insensitive.description: Case Insensitive search: put all wordlist in lower case

stats_db.description: Save reported URI at SQLite local database called stats.db

md5_search.description: Search for a MD5 Hash version of each word

sha1_search.description: Search for a SHA1 Hash version of each word

sha256_search.description: Search for a SHA256 Hash version of each word

hash_upper.description: In case of Hash Search be enabled, also search by Uppercase of Hash Hex Text

no_dupcheck.description: Do not check duplicate words in wordlist
